Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API (invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration).
Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: lambda-api-health
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Dashboard.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9\-_]{1,255}$'
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Lambda function to monitor.
Resources:
  LambdaApiHealthDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody:
        Fn::Sub: |
          {
            "widgets": [
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 0,
                "width": 6,
                "height": 4,
                "properties": {
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Sum" } ]
                  ],
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "title": "Invocations (Sum)",
                  "period": 300,
                  "sparkline": true,
                  "setPeriodToTimeRange": true
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 6,
                "y": 0,
                "width": 6,
                "height": 4,
                "properties": {
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "AWS/Lambda", "Errors", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Sum" } ]
                  ],
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "title": "Errors (Sum)",
                  "period": 300,
                  "sparkline": true,
                  "setPeriodToTimeRange": true
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12,
                "y": 0,
                "width": 6,
                "height": 4,
                "properties": {
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "AWS/Lambda", "Throttles", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Sum" } ]
                  ],
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "title": "Throttles (Sum)",
                  "period": 300,
                  "sparkline": true,
                  "setPeriodToTimeRange": true
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 18,
                "y": 0,
                "width": 6,
                "height": 4,
                "properties": {
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "AWS/Lambda", "Duration", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Average" } ]
                  ],
                  "view": "singleValue",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "title": "Duration (Average, ms)",
                  "period": 300,
                  "sparkline": true,
                  "setPeriodToTimeRange": true
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 4,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 8,
                "properties": {
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Sum", "id": "m1", "color": "#1f77b4" } ],
                    [ ".", "Errors", ".", ".", { "stat": "Sum", "id": "m2", "color": "#d62728" } ],
                    [ ".", "Throttles", ".", ".", { "stat": "Sum", "id": "m3", "color": "#ff7f0e" } ]
                  ],
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "stacked": false,
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "title": "Invocations, Errors, Throttles",
                  "period": 300,
                  "legend": {
                    "position": "bottom"
                  },
                  "yAxis": {
                    "left": {
                      "label": "Count",
                      "showUnits": false
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12,
                "y": 4,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 8,
                "properties": {
                  "metrics": [
                    [ "AWS/Lambda", "Duration", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Average", "id": "m1", "color": "#2ca02c" } ]
                  ],
                  "view": "timeSeries",
                  "stacked": false,
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "title": "Average Duration (ms)",
                  "period": 300,
                  "legend": {
                    "position": "bottom"
                  },
                  "yAxis": {
                    "left": {
                      "label": "Milliseconds",
                      "showUnits": false
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            ]
          }
Outputs:
  DashboardName:
    Description: Name of the created CloudWatch Dashboard
    Value: !Ref DashboardName
  DashboardUrl:
    Description: Console URL to the CloudWatch Dashboard
    Value:
      Fn::Sub: https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${AWS::Region}#dashboards:name=${DashboardName}
